description.zh: 操作ID（有效时间为1小时，超时后无法查询到结果并且返回参数没有Data这一属性）
description.en: The operation ID. This ID is valid for one hour. After the ID expires, you cannot query the result, and the Data property is not returned in the response.

description.zh: 资源组ID，用于资源组相关权限校验
description.en: The ID of the resource group. This parameter is used for permission verification.
